description:
BETA — Impression Share je Microsoft-Ads-Kampagne: impression_share_pct,
lost_to_budget_pct (Budget zu knapp), lost_to_rank_pct (Gebot/Qualität zu
niedrig), top_impression_share_pct, absolute_top_impression_share_pct,
click_share_pct, dazu impressions, clicks, cost. Zeitraum: days (bis
gestern) oder date_from/date_to (YYYY-MM-DD).
workspace: Slug des Kunden-Workspace (optional bei nur einem Workspace).
name: microsoft_ads_impression_share
title: Microsoft Ads (Beta): Impression share
